requirement: When a book is checked out, the borrow's returnDate is computed as loanDate + 30 days.
source_headline: Removed return date computation (returnDate = loanDate + 30 days) from Borrows
label: GAP
evidence: POST /borrows constructs borrow_doc with "returnDate": data.get("returnDate", "") and never computes loanDate + 30 days; PUT /borrows/<borrow_id> only validates returnDate is not before loanDate.
reasoning: There is code handling returnDate fields, so the requirement is addressed only superficially, but the specific required behavior is absent: no logic adds 30 days to loanDate when a book is checked out. A test creating a borrow without returnDate and expecting an auto-computed date 30 days after loanDate would fail, so per the decision guide this is GAP.
